limits.value: concurrency limit per account, counted across all API keys: 2500 concurrent requests for deepseek-flash and 500 for deepseek-v4-pro; HTTP 429 above the limit; higher concurrency is available on request at no additional cost

free_tier.stated: no free tier or signup credit is stated: usage is deducted from a topped-up balance or a granted balance, granted balance first, and no granted amount is published
free_tier.notes: a granted balance can expire: the balance endpoint reports granted_balance as the total not expired granted balance, in CNY or USD; topped-up balances do not expire and an unused balance can be refunded; whether a new account receives a granted balance, and its amount and expiry, are not published on the documentation, terms or help-centre pages and are unverified: behind a sign-up

identity_cost.detail: an API key from an account on platform.deepseek.com, registered by email address with an emailed code or by a Google account; the sign-up page served outside mainland China offers email registration only, WeChat login is limited to mainland-China addresses, and some email domains are refused (Gmail, Outlook, Hotmail or Yahoo are recommended); calls draw on a prepaid balance and an empty balance is refused with an Insufficient Balance error; top-up is online by PayPal, bank card, Alipay or WeChat Pay; the Chinese-language FAQ puts real-name verification (an ID number) before an Alipay or WeChat top-up and opens bank transfer only to enterprise-verified accounts registered with a China-country-code phone number; whether an email-registered account must pass real-name verification before a PayPal or card top-up is unverified: behind a sign-up
